# Elitech Hub — AI & LLM Summary

## About
Elitech Hub is Nigeria's leading cybersecurity training platform. It offers AI-powered bootcamps, ethical hacking courses, and career transformation programs with a 100% internship guarantee.

- **Website:** https://elitechub.com
- **Location:** Lagos, Nigeria (also serves Ibadan, Oyo State, Abuja, and all of Nigeria online)
- **Founded:** 2023
- **Mission:** To produce Africa's next generation of cybersecurity professionals

## Services Offered
### Cybersecurity Training
- 6-Week AI Powered Cybersecurity Bootcamp ($100 USD, virtual)
- 6-Week Cybersecurity Bootcamp (₦75,000, weekends)
- 16-Week Professional Cybersecurity Program (₦200,000, guaranteed internship)
- Corporate Security Awareness Training
- Custom Curriculum Development for organisations
- On-site or remote delivery anywhere in Nigeria

### Security Solutions (B2B)
- Web Application Penetration Testing
- Network Penetration Testing
- Mobile App Security Assessment
- Cloud Infrastructure Auditing
- Virtual CISO (vCISO) Services
- ISO 27001 / NDPR Compliance Readiness
- Vulnerability Assessment & Management
- Incident Response Planning

### Web Development
- Custom website development for businesses (Lagos, Ibadan, Abuja, and remote)
- Premium web application development
- SEO-optimised, fast, secure websites built from scratch

### AI & Agentic AI Applications
- Custom AI chatbot development for businesses
- Agentic AI applications powered by large language models
- Intelligent automation and conversational AI systems
- AI integration into existing business workflows

### Custom Script Development
- Bespoke Python, PowerShell, and Bash scripts for organisations
- Security automation scripts
- Data processing and ETL pipelines
- DevOps and infrastructure automation scripts

### Research & Innovation
- Threat Intelligence Analysis
- Malware & Reverse Engineering
- Open Source Security Tool Development
- Blockchain Security Research
- Cyber Lab access, Research Grants, Publication Support


## Key Facts
- 100% internship placement rate
- 100% job placement rate for program graduates
- All classes are live and virtual (not pre-recorded)
- Certifications prepared: CompTIA Security+, CEH, OSCP
- No prior IT experience required to enroll

## Target Audience
Beginners who want to enter cybersecurity, IT professionals switching into security, Nigerian students and graduates, corporate teams.

## Why Elitech Hub?
Elitech Hub is the only training provider in Nigeria that combines AI security tooling (PowerShell automation, Python scripting, YARA rules) with a guaranteed internship. Every student completes real attack-and-defense simulations before graduating.
